description: Google Cloud Vertex AI EU multi-region offer for supported Gemini and Anthropic Claude inference, with ML processing restricted to EU member states.
residency_notes: The EU jurisdictional endpoint keeps ML processing within EU member states. The United Kingdom and Switzerland are outside this boundary; availability and supported controls remain model- and capability-specific.
regional_pricing_notes: EU multi-region requests use endpoint-specific pricing where Google publishes it. Anthropic partner-model EU rates are 10% above corresponding global rates in Google's official regional pricing tables.
prompt_training_notes: Google Cloud says Vertex AI customer data is not used to train or fine-tune AI/ML models without prior permission or instruction, though some abuse-monitoring and short-lived caching scenarios can still apply.

sources.notes: EU jurisdictional processing boundary and per-model support matrix.
EU multi-region host, location identifier, Claude model coverage, route shape, quotas, and prompt-caching support.
Official regional pricing tables for Google and partner models.

verification.notes: Verified as the EU multi-region variant of Google Vertex AI. Native text routes use aiplatform.eu.rep.googleapis.com with locations/eu; the catalog is limited to models explicitly documented for EU multi-region processing.
